messages:
lena_marketing: planning a cross-region micro-summit next Thurs — two parallel hubs (NA / EMEA) with the same agenda. need registration page copy, zoom/RTMP routing, and post-event clip plan. can we A/B test CTA wording and collect company size + job function?

ops_ryan: for multi-hub, recommend separate Zoom meetings per hub to avoid load and timezone overlap. each meeting streams to its own RTMP endpoint and writes cloud recording. backup plan: simultaneous RTMP -> ingest service (k8s) that republishes to s3.

nick_prod: agree on two meetings. routing rules: primary RTMP -> CDN ingest, fallback RTMP -> secondary ingest endpoint. also capture participant join logs (email, company) for watch tracking. here's a minimal ffmpeg capture we used: 
```
ffmpeg -listen 1 -i rtmp://0.0.0.0:1935/live/stream -c copy -f mp4 -movflags +frag_keyframe+empty_moov s3://events-ingest/%Y%m%d_%H%M%S.mp4
```
remember to rotate keys per-hub.

sarah_creative: reg page notes: test CTAs — "request a performance benchmark" vs "try the latency demo". Add dropdowns for company size (1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-1000, 1000+) and job function (Eng, Product, Ops, Exec). include one checkbox for "reuse recording for marketing" and a second checkbox for "I give consent to be featured" addressed to speakers. short privacy blurb and link to policy.

lena_marketing: i'll draft copy. UTMs: utm_source=announce, utm_campaign=multihub-summit, utm_content=cta_variant. map CTA variants to hubspot list membership. need HubSpot fields: hs_event_name, hub, c_company_size, c_job_function, c_consented_recording. any objections?

ops_ryan: Zoom setup checklist: enable cloud recording (record gallery + shared screen), enable live stream to custom service, disable auto transcription (we run our pipeline), enable host video spotlight by default. schedule a 30m technical dress rehearsal per hub. also provision an OBS fallback VM per hub with preloaded keys.

nick_prod: ingestion metadata: for each recording create metadata flat file with: event_id, hub, meeting_id, stream_key_hash, speakers, start_ts, end_ts. transcription job kicks off whisper-v2 -> segments produced (hero 0-120s, highlight 120-420s, technical deep-dive 420-1800s). produce 16:9 master + 1:1 social slices with burned captions and separate VTT. deliver masters to CDN and register asset links in the event row in HubSpot.

sarah_creative: email cadence: immediate thank-you + calendar + slide deck link; 24h send hero clip + CTA variant depending on CTA clicked; 72h send technical deep-dive clip to engaged viewers (>=30% watch or clip click); 7d automated nurture: tag for SDR if company_size >= 51 and watched >=50%. create short social posts (3 variants) per hub timed 2h after event.

lena_marketing: legal: need speaker consent copy. @legalbot can you confirm a one-liner: "I consent to Redwood Inference using my session recording and likeness for marketing and product materials"? also confirm retention window (default 12 months unless opted out).

legalbot: confirmed. retention 12 months, opt-out link included in post-event email. suggest adding a per-speaker checkbox on the reg form and a required last-minute opt-in in the speaker onboarding doc.

streambot: automated reminders scheduled: 24h and 1h pre-event to speakers; RTMP key healthcheck 45m before start; ingest endpoint smoke test 20m prior.

ops_ryan: I'll post RTMP keys and OBS VM IPs in #eng-ops 1 hour before. also will run a smoke ffmpeg test and paste logs here.

nick_prod: create a short fallback loop (branded slide + music) stored on the OBS VM to play for up to 5 minutes if stream fails. assign a standby producer to flip to fallback.

sarah_creative: I'll prepare caption styling guide and three thumbnail options for the clips. sharing asset plan doc in ~45m: https://docs.redwood/events/multihub-summit/assets

lena_marketing: volunteers for dress rehearsal? propose Wed 10am for NA hub, Wed 3pm for EMEA hub. please react if you can.

streambot: reminder posted to speakers channel for rehearsals.
